name: Laying On Hands
overview: The practice of laying on hands in Scripture is closely associated with the impartation of the Holy Spirit and commissioning for ministry, as seen when believers received the Holy Ghost through the apostles laying hands on them (Acts 8:17; Acts 19:6). It also signifies the sending forth of individuals after prayer and fasting (Acts 13:3). Hebrews 6:2 highlights laying on of hands as a foundational doctrine alongside baptisms and eternal judgment, underscoring its spiritual significance within the Christian faith.
